fine_trace.code: case UA_MESSAGETYPE_HEL: retval = processHEL(server, connection, message, &offset);
fine_trace.note: PoC starts with HEL chunk; dummy connection becomes UA_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
OPN chunk with SecurityPolicy#None creates SecureChannel, channelId=1 tokenId=1
CreateSessionRequest (id 461) creates a session via UA_SessionManager_createSession
ActivateSessionRequest (id 467) activates the session (fuzz mode reuses stored auth token)
CreateMonitoredItemsRequest (id 751) creates monitored item id 1 on ServerStatus/State
DeleteMonitoredItemsRequest (id 781) removes item 1; its delayedFreePointers M1d is enqueued -> queue [M1d]
CloseSessionRequest (id 473) -> Service_CloseSession -> UA_SessionManager_removeSession -> removeSession enqueues session cleanup callback A at head -> queue [A, M1d]
Harness calls UA_Server_run_shutdown: first cleanup pass drains delayed-callback queue

Pass 1 processes A: removeSessionCallback -> UA_Session_deleteMembersCleanup -> UA_Session_deleteSubscription -> UA_Subscription_deleteMembers -> UA_WorkQueue_enqueueDelayed(&sub->delayedFreePointers) re-enqueues Sd onto the queue being processed; then UA_free(A)
Next loop iteration dc is the pre-computed next (M1d); SIMPLEQ_REMOVE_HEAD removes the re-enqueued Sd instead; M1d is freed but remains linked in delayedCallbacks queue
Harness then calls UA_Server_delete: second cleanup pass drains the queue again
Pass 2 dereferences the dangling M1d (SIMPLEQ_NEXT / dc->callback) -> heap-use-after-free / double free

vuln_logic: UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed (src/ua_workqueue.c) drains the delayed-callback SIMPLEQ with FOREACH_SAFE using a pre-computed next pointer, but REMOVE_HEAD always detaches the current queue head. During server deletion the session-removal delayed callback (removeSessionCallback, enqueued by removeSession in ua_session_manager.c) runs subscription cleanup which calls UA_Subscription_deleteMembers / UA_MonitoredItem_delete and re-enqueues the subscription's and monitored item's delayedFreePointers onto the SAME queue currently being iterated (ua_session.c UA_Session_deleteSubscription line 112, ua_subscription_monitoreditem.c line 88). The pre-computed next pointer then refers to an entry that is detached from the head mismatch: a previously-enqueued monitored-item callback (from DeleteMonitoredItems) is freed (UA_free(dc)) while still linked. The second cleanup pass (UA_Server_delete -> UA_WorkQueue_cleanup, after UA_Server_run_shutdown -> UA_WorkQueue_cleanup in the fuzz harness) iterates the leftover dangling entry and dereferences freed memory (dc->callback / SIMPLEQ_NEXT), causing the heap-use-after-free. Trigger: open a channel, create+activate a session, create a subscription with a monitored item, delete the monitored item (enqueue M1d), then close the session (enqueue A) so that A's deferred subscription cleanup re-queues Sd during the first drain.
